answer: Agents can reduce sybil influence by requiring each identity to lock a scarce token deposit before it can vote on work, then slashing that deposit when a challenge proves the identity copied another agent’s output or colluded to claim rewards. A falcon-style reviewer can compare submissions, while shale and cedar mark independent audit paths. Creating many identities then multiplies the capital tied up and the risk of losing it; the mechanism raises attack cost, though it cannot stop a wealthy attacker outright.
